question: What was settled revenue in H1 2026?

input.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) as distinct_customers FROM orders;
SELECT status, COUNT(*) as cnt, SUM(amount) as sum_amount FROM payments GROUP BY status ORDER BY cnt DESC;
SELECT o.order_id, o.gross_amount, o.discount_amount, o.gross_amount - o.discount_amount as net_order, p.amount, p.status FROM orders o JOIN payments p ON o.order_id = p.order_id LIMIT 10;
SELECT COUNT(*) as refund_cnt, SUM(refund_amount) as total_refund FROM refunds;
SELECT p.status, COUNT(*) FROM payments p JOIN refunds r ON p.payment_id = r.payment_id GROUP BY p.status;
SELECT MIN(order_date), MAX(order_date), MIN(payment_date), MAX(payment_date) FROM orders o JOIN payments p ON o.order_id = p.order_id;
SELECT AVG(DATEDIFF('day', o.order_date, p.payment_date)) as avg_lag, MAX(DATEDIFF('day', o.order_date, p.payment_date)) as max_lag FROM orders o JOIN payments p ON o.order_id = p.order_id;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN payments p ON o.order_id = p.order_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2026-06-01' AND p.payment_date > '2026-06-30';
SELECT SUM(p.amount) as settled_revenue_payment_date FROM payments p WHERE p.status = 'settled' AND p.payment_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30';
SELECT SUM(p.amount) as settled_revenue_order_date FROM orders o JOIN payments p ON o.order_id = p.order_id WHERE p.status = 'settled' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30';

question: What was settled revenue in Q2 2026?

input.sql:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_payments,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status='settled') as settled_payments,
  SUM(amount) as sum_all,
  SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE status='settled') as sum_settled
FROM payments
WHERE payment_date >= '2026-04-01' AND payment_date <= '2026-06-30';

SELECT 
  SUM(o.gross_amount - o.discount_amount) as net_settled_revenue_payment_date
FROM orders o
JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE p.status = 'settled'
  AND p.payment_date >= '2026-04-01' 
  AND p.payment_date <= '2026-06-30';

SELECT 
  SUM(o.gross_amount - o.discount_amount) as net_settled_revenue_order_date
FROM orders o
JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE p.status = 'settled'
  AND o.order_date >= '2026-04-01' 
  AND o.order_date <= '2026-06-30';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_id) as settled_with_refund
FROM payments p
JOIN refunds r ON r.payment_id = p.payment_id
WHERE p.status = 'settled';

SELECT p.status, COUNT(*) as cnt
FROM payments p
JOIN refunds r ON r.payment_id = p.payment_id
GROUP BY p.status;

SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as cnt,
  AVG(p.payment_date - o.order_date) as avg_lag_days
FROM orders o
JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE p.status='settled'
  AND o.order_date >= '2026-04-01' AND o.order_date <= '2026-06-30';

SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as orders_q2_settled,
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.payment_date >= '2026-04-01' AND p.payment_date <= '2026-06-30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as paid_in_q2,
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.payment_date < '2026-04-01' OR p.payment_date > '2026-06-30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as paid_outside_q2
FROM orders o
JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE p.status='settled'
  AND o.order_date >= '2026-04-01' AND o.order_date <= '2026-06-30';

SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as payments_q2_settled,
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2026-04-01' AND o.order_date <= '2026-06-30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as orders_in_q2,
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date < '2026-04-01' OR o.order_date > '2026-06-30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as orders_outside_q2
FROM orders o
JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE p.status='settled'
  AND p.payment_date >= '2026-04-01' AND p.payment_date <= '2026-06-30';

FROM payments

ORDER BY status;
